notes: Spaces can carry Ethernet: a TAP-Windows6 adapter, a MAC-learning switch with real broadcast and multicast, and an owner switch between IP and Ethernet. Layer 3 is unchanged and still the default. Windows only. The installer is unsigned. Known issue: across a real NAT tunnel the layer-2 ping does not complete yet; ARP resolves but the peer's unicast replies are not accepted consistently. Treat layer 2 as experimental and expect to reproduce that before trusting it.
